popCulture.title: Belus (Egyptian)
popCulture.description: Son of Poseidon and Libya, twin of Agenor, king of Egypt — father of Danaus and Aegyptus. Not Belus of Babylon, nor every Near Eastern Bel conflated with him.

popCulture.title: Danaus
popCulture.description: Belus' son — the twin who flees to Argos with fifty daughters after the Egyptian succession splits.

popCulture.title: Aegyptus
popCulture.description: Belus' other twin son — eponym of Egypt in the feud that arms the Danaids' wedding night.

popCulture.title: Agenor
popCulture.description: Belus' twin who takes Phoenicia — the brother-line that sends Europa and Cadmus west while Belus holds the Nile.
